Headquarters: EMEA Remote

About Customer.io

Over 10,000 companies from scrappy startups to global brands use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Sales Manager to build and lead a new team of 6–8 Account Executives in our Mid-Market organization. The EMEA org is already running this sales motion successfully; you’ll be responsible for ramping and leading your team, establishing its operating rhythm, and shaping its approach to territories and pipeline generation as needed.

This is a frontline leadership role. You’ll translate our go-to-market strategy into consistent team execution by coaching reps, inspecting deals, driving forecast accuracy, and creating the structure for strong performance to repeat quarter after quarter.

What you'll own:

Lead and develop a high-performing team

• Coach Account Executives to consistently meet or exceed quota and grow into their next role

• Run focused 1:1s built around deal quality, skill development, and real accountability

• Ramp new reps quickly and address performance gaps early, before they compound

• Build a team culture rooted in ownership, collaboration, and high standards

Drive pipeline health and forecast accuracy

• Lead weekly pipeline and forecast reviews focused on deal progression, qualification rigor, and clear next steps

• Sharpen predictability through disciplined inspection and clean CRM hygiene across the team

• Maintain healthy pipeline coverage and address creation gaps before they become quarter-enders

• Reinforce structured, rep-owned outbound tied to measurable standards and pipeline outcomes

• Use activity, conversion, and pipeline data to test and improve outbound effectiveness over time.

Support high-quality deal execution

• Coach reps to run well-qualified mid-market opportunities from discovery through close

• Elevate deal strategy with stronger positioning, cleaner value articulation, confident executive-level communication

• Help reps navigate pricing, stakeholder alignment, and procurement without losing momentum

• Identify patterns in stalled deals and use them to improve execution across the team.

Partner cross-functionally

• Work with Sales Ops, Marketing, and Solutions Architects to unblock deals and improve how the team executes

• Bring frontline feedback on messaging, territory design, and enablement back to the people who own it

• Pilot new go-to-market initiatives with your team, then turn what works into repeatable practices.

What we're looking for:

• 7–10 years of sales experience, including 3–5+ years managing quota-carrying reps, ideally in marketing technology or SaaS

• This role is only open to candidates based in the United Kingdom or Ireland.

• A track record of leading successful mid-market or high-velocity sales teams, including building or evolving outbound teams and motions.

• Genuinely strong at pipeline inspection and forecasting - you can sniff out a soft deal from a mile away

• Experienced in coaching outbound pipeline generation and improving outbound motions as the business evolves

• Comfortable operating inside a structured qualification framework like MEDDICC

• A clear, direct communicator who sets high expectations, gives candid feedback, and treats people with respect

• Effective cross-functionally in a collaborative, fast-moving, growth-stage environment

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Compensation for this role is $145,000 base + $145,000 variable = $290,000 OTE (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute conversation with a Recruiter

• 45-minute conversation with the Hiring Manager

• 1:1 conversations with cross-functional partners

• One week to complete a take-home assignment, followed by a 60-minute review call

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-sr-sales-manager-mid-market-uk-ireland-remote

b58c02acec65789b.description: **[Allminds](https://getallminds.com)** is a mental healthcare technology company. Our mission is to bring high-quality, affordable mental healthcare to everyone, regardless of their location or financial situation. We started in 2019, are largely bootstrapped, profitable, and growing rapidly. We simplify the process for patients to obtain insurance-reimbursed therapy by pairing them with their preferred therapist. Our platform enables therapists to maintain a high-quality caseload, establish a thriving practice, and equips them with advanced technology and support. Our dedicated team is committed to creating a positive impact in the lives of countless individuals seeking mental health support. We are currently looking for an experienced and talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our team and help us make a difference. **Responsibilities**: Collaborate with the founders to develop, implement, and maintain a high-quality web application. Utilize React JS, HTML, and CSS for front-end development, ensuring a seamless and responsive user experience. Develop and maintain server-side applications using Node JS and Python for back-end development. Integrate APIs to streamline processes and enhance the functionality of our platform. Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that follows best practices and industry standards. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize our web applications to enhance performance and maintain scalability. Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback to continuously improve the quality of our codebase. Communicate effectively with team members to ensure successful project completion and a positive work environment. **Requirements**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 6+ years of professional experience in full-stack software development, with a focus on web development. Deep understanding of scalable system architecture and building performant applications Strong proficiency in React JS, HTML, and CSS for front-end development. Extensive experience with Node JS and Python for back-end development. API integration experience strongly preferred. Familiarity with Google Cloud and Firebase is strongly preferred. Familiarity with building secure backend systems and dev ops is strongly preferred. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies. Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment. Passion for our mission to provide affordable, high-quality mental healthcare to all. **What We Offer**: Competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience. Opportunity to work remotely, with a flexible schedule that promotes work-life balance. A supportive and collaborative work environment, where your contributions will have a direct impact on countless lives. Opportunities for personal and professional growth within a fast-growing, innovative company. If you are an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a passion for making a difference, we would love to hear from you. **Process**: If you’re interested, please submit your resume and a link to your github profile, outlining your relevant experience and interest in our mission. We’ll conduct 4 interviews: 1 Screening interview (Both technical and behavioral) 1 Coding interview 1 System design interview 1 Behavioral interview All interviews will be conducted by the co-founders of the team. **About Allminds**: Allminds was founded by [Juan Ordonez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jdordonez/) & [Gagan Mac](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gaganmac/) in San Francisco in 2019 to make high-quality mental healthcare more accessible. The company is backed by the Berkeley House Fund, and is profitable.

The Opportunity

The Associate Big Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data engineering solutions that enable trusted data, advanced analytics, and actionable business insights across MetLife's global operations. This role contributes to MetLife's Data & Analytics vision by supporting the collection, processing, storage, and delivery of structured and unstructured data across cloud and on-premise environments.

Guided by MetLife's purpose of "Always with you, building a more confident future," this position offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern big data technologies, cloud platforms, and enterprise-scale analytics ecosystems. The role provides exposure to end-to-end data engineering practices, collaboration with global teams, and opportunities to contribute to innovative data and AI-driven initiatives that create measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT data pipelines on Azure cloud and on-premises platforms for large-scale data ingestion and processing.
• Develop scalable data engineering solutions using technologies such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Python, and SQL.
• Ensure data quality, security, governance, and compliance standards are consistently followed throughout the data lifecycle.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, technology teams, operations teams, and Data & Analytics functions to deliver reliable data solutions.
• Support batch and real-time data processing requirements using cloud-native services including Azure Data Factory, Event Hub, Azure Functions, Databricks, and Synapse Analytics.
• Contribute to data warehouse, data mart, and data lake initiatives to enable enterprise reporting, analytics, and data science solutions.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• 0-3 years of experience in Data Engineering, Big Data, Data Analytics, or related technology domains.
• Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python or Scala.
• Experience with ETL/ELT pipeline development and data integration processes.
• Knowledge of Big Data technologies including Apache Spark, Hadoop, and Hive.
• Familiarity with Azure cloud services such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Event Hub, and Azure Functions.
• Understanding of NoSQL and distributed databases such as HBase and Cosmos DB.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and fast-paced team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Exposure to GenAI technologies, AI-powered development tools, or machine learning concepts.
• Knowledge of data warehouses, data marts, and data lake architectures.
• Understanding of data governance, data quality, and data modeling principles.
• Experience working in cloud-based data engineering environments.
• Demonstrated curiosity, learning agility, and a passion for emerging technologies and innovation.
• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

b548529bf9958a01.description:
Headquarters: New York City
 
URL: https://sanctuary.computer

We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK — Media

At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

⛰️ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

️ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

 Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, here’s an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years →

• Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary …

Join our Equity Research team in Mumbai and help deepen our footprint within an exciting and growing market, leveraging the strengths of the Macquarie platform. You will be working as a writing analyst, leading the coverage of India Healthcare & Pharmaceutical sectors in an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

 What role will you play? 

Reporting to the Head of India Equity Research, you will leverage your expertise to identify and articulate compelling investment opportunities. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality research through rigorous market analysis, detailed financial modeling and insightful reports that guide institutional clients’ decisions. You will actively engage with senior stakeholders at covered companies, maintain strong industry relationships and provide timely, actionable insights that reflect both company-specific fundamentals and broader macro trends.

In addition, you are expected to drive thought leadership and uphold the highest standards of accuracy and clarity in every piece of research you produce, actively contribute to our Asia regional product, and stay on top of emerging themes to guide investment decisions.

What You Offer

• Excellent academic qualifications in finance or related disciplines
• 7+ years’ experience in equity research (buy-side or sell-side) with the relevant expertise in India Healthcare and Pharmaceutical sectors
• Exceptional analytical and writing skills, with a proven ability to deliver actionable insights
• Strong communication skills with a solid track record of building relationships with institutional clients and internal stakeholders globally
• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Benefits

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

• 1 wellbeing leave day per year
• 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
• Company-subsidised childcare services
• 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
• Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
• Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
• Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
• Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
• Reimbursement for work from home equipment

About Macquarie Capital 

Macquarie Capital partners with businesses, startups and governments to connect ideas to capital and help drive innovation, growth and create real-world impact. Our global corporate advisory, investing, development and equities capabilities are underpinned by a full spectrum of capital markets solutions and deep sector expertise, with a focus on infrastructure and real assets, technology, software and services, and resources, energy and materials.

 Inclusion at Macquarie 

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

Who We Are

Bayzat is at the forefront of transforming workplaces through innovative solutions in HR, Payroll, Finance, and Insurance. Renowned as a leading SaaS platform for employee benefits and a key player in the Insurance sector, we are committed to our mission: empower every company to create a remarkable workplace by supercharging people processes and payments.

As one of the MENA region's fastest-growing Scale-Ups, Bayzat is celebrated for its innovative product offerings, backed by over 300 team members from 35+ nationalities. Recognized by Forbes as a promising UAE-based startup and supported by leading VCs like Mubadala and Point72 Ventures, we are among the best-funded HRTech scale-ups in the region.

At Bayzat, culture is paramount. We are a principle-driven, merit-based organization where authenticity, collaboration, and unpretentiousness thrive. Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimize efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer to design scalable data models, build robust pipelines, and ensure reliable, high-quality data across the company. You will own our data infrastructure end-to-end, enabling smarter decisions, automation, and personalized customer experiences.

Some High-impact Responsibilities You Will Be Entrusted With

• Designing the data model for data collection in the data warehouse
• Data Collection and data storage from existing and new data sources to the Data Warehouse and Data Lakes
• Building ELT/ETL solutions to enable batch processing and real-time data processing
• Maintaining data pipelines and monitoring data pipeline health
• Promoting data quality through Data Fitness, Data Lineage, Data Governance, and Data Stability
• Performing query performance tuning on the data warehouse for faster and reliable data querying through BI tools
• Using Master Data Management techniques like Customer 360 to integrate all the customer data and interactions to have a comprehensive view of customers to provide a personalized user experience
• Building automation workflows and integrations for data transfer to various tools and applications
• Working with internal stakeholders to maintain and improve data lifecycle in the company

What You Will Need To Have

• Relevant experience of 3 - 4 years.
• Experience in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries
• Experience in programming languages like Python
• Experience in managing data warehouses, such as Bigquery or Snowflake 
• Experience with 3NF, Dimensional Models, and Data Vault
• Expertise in building ETL pipelines and data pipeline frameworks like Airbyte, AWS Firehose, Airflow, dbt
• Experience with engineering processes like Unit Testing and CI/CD
• Hands-on experience in AWS ecosystem
• Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Looker and Superset
• Outstanding critical thinking and analytical skills
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently as well as in a team and comfortable in a dynamic environment
• Efficiently organized and detail-oriented, able to ensure quality and accuracy of the output
• Ability to build strong relationships with colleagues, effectively collaborating across departments

What's In It For You

At Bayzat, we don't sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture — we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You'll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you'll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

Here's What You Can Expect

• Meritocracy at its core: Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.
• Freedom to shape your path: We support cross-functional moves and growth transitions when you drive value.
• Real feedback culture: Feedback is coaching — empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
• Barrier-free collaboration: Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you'll have a seat at the table — even with the CEO.
• Accelerated growth: Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
